Package com.hiface.sdk.access

Class HiFaceAccess

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.access.HiFaceAccess
public final class HiFaceAccess extends java.lang.Object
Optional fully offline file import and status entry. Each method prepares the platform, runs serially in the background, and delivers its callback on the main thread.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public static void initialize(@NonNull android.content.Context context, @NonNull HiFaceResultCallback<java.lang.Boolean> callback)
      Optional warm-up. File import and status queries prepare the platform automatically. Success indicates initialization only; getStatus and each SDK operation determine actual validity.

    • exportActivationRequest

      public static void exportActivationRequest(@NonNull android.content.Context context, @NonNull android.net.Uri destination, @NonNull HiFaceResultCallback<java.lang.Boolean> callback)
      Optionally export an application/device-model reference. This is not a prerequisite for file import.

    • exportRecoveryRequest

      public static void exportRecoveryRequest(@NonNull android.content.Context context, @NonNull android.net.Uri destination, @NonNull HiFaceResultCallback<java.lang.Boolean> callback)
      Recovery helper. After correcting system time, export a public reference of the current latched status for the vendor to issue a single-use recovery certificate. This method exports no keys and does not clear the error.

    • importLicense

      public static void importLicense(@NonNull android.content.Context context, @NonNull android.net.Uri source, @NonNull HiFaceResultCallback<java.lang.Boolean> callback)
      Import a local .hflic file without separate initialization or manual file storage. Stop active operations and close the existing SDK before calling; create a new SDK after success. Later startups restore the saved authorization automatically. Errors from file access or the platform are reported through the callback.

    • getStatus

      public static void getStatus(@NonNull android.content.Context context, @NonNull HiFaceResultCallback<HiFaceAccessInfo> callback)
      Optional query that prepares the platform automatically. Snapshots are for display; the SDK still validates actual operations.
